answer: About 1 second of fixed overhead per micro-batch cycle (planning and committing offsets), per pa_pattern_batch_or_stream_intermediate.md. At a 2 s trigger, about half of the time (~50%) goes to overhead. At a 100 ms trigger, almost all of the time (~90%+, effectively nearly all) goes to overhead. Below about 1 s the micro-batch model stops paying, which is why a record-at-a-time engine exists.
